params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $dir=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'actions-runner-heaven'; Write-Output '=== PROCESSES ==='; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'Runner\.(Listener|Worker)' -or ($_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match 'actions-runner-heaven') } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CreationDate,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | Format-List | Out-String | Write-Output; Write-Output '=== DIAG ==='; $diag=Join-Path $dir '_diag'; if(Test-Path $diag){ Get-ChildItem $diag -File | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc -Descending | Select-Object -First 4 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('--- '+$_.Name+' '+$_.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('o')); Get-Content -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Tail 80 } }
